body: Current Astra has one owner with paired devices and instance-wide project/root configuration. One daemon could support separate users through user identities, project/root grants and server-side authorization. Separate instances of the same binary with disjoint project folders are the current alternative. Private versus shared projects remains unspecified; no implementation, scope or acceptance decision was made. Evidence: progress/2026-10-04-multi-user-folder-review.md. Documentation/package checks pass; no application code or runtime configuration was changed.

metadata.summary: Reviewed separate user access to project folders
